name: statements are split on semicolons
sql:
CREATE TABLE a (id INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX a_id ON a (id);

name: the last statement may omit the semicolon
semicolons in strings and quoted identifiers are kept
semicolons in comments are kept
a comment after the last statement is not a statement
a trigger body ends with END
a CASE END inside a trigger does not end it
sql: create temp trigger t after insert on a begin update b set x = case when 1 then 2 end; end; select 1
statements: create temp trigger t after insert on a begin update b set x = case when 1 then 2 end; end

name: TEMPORARY and IF NOT EXISTS triggers
sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS t BEFORE DELETE ON a BEGIN SELECT 1; END; SELECT 2
statements: CREATE TEMPORARY TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS t BEFORE DELETE ON a BEGIN SELECT 1; END

name: trigger as an identifier is not a trigger
sql: CREATE TABLE trigger_log (trigger TEXT); SELECT trigger FROM trigger_log; SELECT 1

name: identifiers named like object properties
sql: SELECT constructor, __proto__, toString FROM t; SELECT 1

name: EXPLAIN statements
sql: EXPLAIN SELECT 1; EXPLAIN CREATE TRIGGER t AFTER INSERT ON a BEGIN SELECT 1; END; SELECT 2
statements: EXPLAIN CREATE TRIGGER t AFTER INSERT ON a BEGIN SELECT 1; END

name: non-ASCII text
sql: INSERT INTO t VALUES ('žluťoučký;kůň'); SELECT ünïcödé FROM t

name: an unterminated string is an error
an unterminated quoted identifier is an error
an unterminated block comment is an error
